question.text: SEBI introduced common disclosure standards and PPM templates for different categories of AIFs via which landmark circular?

answer.text: SEBI Circular dated June 19, 2014 on material changes to PPM.
SEBI Circular No. SEBI/HO/IMD/DF6/CIR/P/2020/24 dated Feb 05, 2020 on disclosure standards for AIFs.
SEBI Circular dated October 21, 2021 on modalities for filing PPM through Merchant Banker.
SEBI Circular dated June 24, 2022 on Large Value Funds for Accredited Investors.

explanation.text: The Logic: Perceiving the need for common disclosure, SEBI issued Circular SEBI/HO/IMD/DF6/CIR/P/2020/24 dated Feb 05, 2020 prescribing templates of PPM for different categories of AIFs. The summary disclosures (Sections I to XV) under Section A of the PPM are enumerated from this circular. The Trap: June 2014 is the material-changes / compulsory exit circular. Oct 2021 is the merchant-banker filing modalities circular. June 2022 is the LVF guidelines circular. Do not confuse these surrounding circulars with the core Feb 2020 PPM-template circular. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C also tests the Feb 2020 template date. XIX-A Distributor typically only asks 'does SEBI prescribe a template' — yes — without drilling into the circular number. Manager's Pro-Tip: When auditing PPM compliance internally, tag each section A disclosure (I through XV) against the 2020 template so your annual PPM audit is a check-the-box exercise rather than a scramble.
